description: This script generates a tar archive containing firmware images and related upgrade scripts for Linksys switches in the OpenWrt project. It creates various scripts for image checking, upgrading NOR/NAND, and compiles firmware information, packaging everything into a tar file.

methods.name: gen_imagecheck
methods.description: Generates a shell script for verifying the hardware model based on input parameter.

methods.name: gen_fwinfo
methods.description: Outputs firmware version and boot version information.

methods.name: gen_nor_upgrade
methods.description: Generates a NOR flash upgrade script tailored for specific device partitions.

methods.name: gen_nand_upgrade
methods.description: Generates a NAND flash upgrade script tailored for specific device partitions.
